planConstraints: Figma Starter does not support multiple modes in one collection; dark and light are separate single-mode semantic collections.
Figma Starter is limited to three pages, so the documentation structure is compressed into Cover, Foundations + Getting Started, and Components + Utilities.
The Figma MCP call limit was reached after the cover was created; foundations documentation and component canvases remain pending.
Phase 9 frames are specified in docs/phase-9-figma-frames.md because the connected Starter/View seat exhausted MCP tool calls again during implementation.
